title: console: the lookup quick-picker does not reliably take the choice — after a search the pick is lost; without a search it sticks but still reads "Select…"
body:
Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, the maintainer's browser pass of 2026-10-20. Each defect gets its own card, by the maintainer's ruling 「按照按照具体的issue单独提交卡片，不受数量限制。」 (recorded on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, `6283467378`). This is finding **F-13** of track 2 (Setup as the system administrator), by the cloud tester `session_01VuXyJvhGKJy8qeUvhKyxzv`. It was measured on HotCRM `main` `f22dfa52` with `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.5, in Chromium at 1440×900 on a locally booted, seeded install. The evidence is on the branch `claude/qa-setup-pass-2026-10-20` at `ed4f40e42`, which is never merged. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 2 (`os-support-ai`, session `session_01KqkTQNLcxVc588eZpJmp1r`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade: triage's.

**Reader (who acts):** objectui triage routes it. Paths under `src/` are HotCRM's (objectstack-ai/hotcrm).

## The finding, as measured

- **Persona / URL:** dev admin; Delegations → New; Users → Set Manager; Business Units → New (parent).
- **Actual:**
  - After typing a search term and clicking the matching option, nothing is set: Delegations → "Please check the highlighted fields: Delegator, Delegate"; Set Manager → "Manager is required" (reproduced with a text click, keyboard Enter and a mouse click at the option's coordinates).
  - Without typing, clicking an option does set the value (the request carried `parent_business_unit_id`), but the trigger keeps showing "Select…".
  - The "Browse all records" grid next to it works every time.
- **Evidence:** [`21-F-delegations-lookup-not-set.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/21-F-delegations-lookup-not-set.png), [`07-people-users-set-manager-state.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/07-people-users-set-manager-state.png), [`09-people-business-units-parent-lookup.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/09-people-business-units-parent-lookup.png), [`07-people-users-set-manager-browse.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/07-people-users-set-manager-browse.png).
- **class: a.** **Reach:** every lookup in Setup dialogs.
- **Suspected landing:** objectui lookup field (`lookup-trigger-*` popover) in the console.
- **Dedupe words:** lookup select not applied, lookup label shows Select after choosing, lookup quick picker.

## Seat review

- **Landing (seat review):** objectui's lookup field.

## Dedupe

Method: semantic `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack and objectstack-ai/objectui, open and closed, using the finding's own dedupe words and a second phrasing; plus a grep of every issue title (objectstack #1–#24751, objectui #7–#13153) listed through the repo-scoped `issues?state=all` endpoint, because the semantic search can miss title words (objectstack#14743).
- 17 + 13 hits in objectui, 3 in objectstack. The nearest are objectui#2125 (the inline editor shows the placeholder, closed 2026-07-01) and #10713 (search answers can land out of order, closed). Neither covers this. **New.**
